summary: Declares that a RUNTIME -- the tool a host actually executes its agents on -- is a declared subject rather than a thing each surface hand-writes its own version of. The kit ships CLASSES, which say what is true of a runtime as a KIND: how an agent reaches it at all, and which translation sits in the gap. The host authors DESCRIPTORS, which say only what a host legitimately says about its own tool. No vendor's name appears in a class or in the interpreter, because the name of a product is the one thing about a runtime guaranteed not to be true of the kind. Where a product LOOKS for its instructions is true of the product everywhere and of no kind and no host, so it is declared in exactly one place -- a SURFACE, the one declaration allowed to carry a product's name (ADR-013), which this kit ships the GRAMMAR of and never an instance: every surface arrives in an ADAPTER, an ordinary capability a host takes through the provenance door, and is found by the contract its document keeps rather than by a list of publishers (ADR-014) -- and a host SERVES a surface by naming it from its own descriptor: the files that product reads at its fixed paths are then projections of what the host already declared, rebuilt on every render and recorded in the projection plane before a byte is written outside it. The reason this exists as a capability at all is a failure that has already happened here: a runtime's capabilities were WRITTEN DOWN and believed, an invocation shape among them was never measured, and a peer runtime later reported all eight of its claimed capabilities as unproven -- correctly. So the grammar refuses to let a belief become a fact by being written confidently: a descriptor has no field a proof can be written in, the capability vocabulary is declared so that what a runtime does NOT claim has a name instead of being silence, and every surface places every declared capability in exactly one of CLAIMED, PROVEN and ABSENT. It ships no roster of runtimes: a host that runs none says so in those words.

references.because: this runtime asks to be served through a surface nobody declares, so nothing states which paths it reads or what form a file must take there -- and nothing is written for it. A host that believes it serves a runtime while that runtime reads nothing the kit produced is the most expensive silence there is: every instruction reads as delivered.
references.instead: a surface from an adapter this host has TAKEN -- the kit core ships none (ADR-014) -- or, when no published adapter exists for the product, an adapter declared first: a capability whose document keeps the runtime-surface contract, naming the paths the product reads and the template each file takes. Served files are then projections like any other, and a new runtime is that adapter and nothing else.

references.because: this runtime composes a class that neither the kit nor this host declares, so there is no body under the descriptor -- nothing states how an agent reaches it, and nothing states which translation sits in the gap. The descriptor still renders, saying UNBOUND in those words, which is the surface being honest rather than the defect being tolerated: a descriptor alone reads exactly like a complete account of a runtime to anyone who only opens the file.
references.instead: declared as a class first -- in the kit if it is true of a kind of tool anywhere, in this host's own registry if it is not. A runtime with no shipped ancestor is not an exception to the grammar; it is a class this host declares and a descriptor that names it.

references.because: this runtime claims a capability no vocabulary declares. That is not a harmless spelling: an unclaimed capability is supposed to be countable, and it is only countable because every word that may be claimed was declared first. A claim outside the vocabulary is a belief that appears on the surface while belonging to no column, and the count of what this runtime does not claim goes on reading as complete.
references.instead: declared as a capability first, with the one thing that would have to HAPPEN for it to stop being a claim written beside it. A capability whose proof nobody specified is proven by consensus, which is testimony wearing a lab coat.
